title: Find All People With Secret
summary: Given n people numbered 0 to n-1, and a 2D array of meetings where each meeting involves two people and a time, person 0 shares a secret with person firstPerson at time 0.
statement: Given n people numbered 0 to n-1, and a 2D array of meetings where each meeting involves two people and a time, person 0 shares a secret with person firstPerson at time 0. The secret is shared during each meeting between people who have the secret. Return a list of all people who have the secret after all meetings, in any order.
constraints: Person zero tells first_person at time zero.
At one timestamp, the secret may propagate through any connected chain of meetings at that same time.
Return all people who know the secret after processing every timestamp.
hints: Meetings at the same timestamp must be processed together because propagation is instantaneous within that group.
Sort by time; build a temporary graph for one timestamp and BFS from every participant who already knows.
Mark every vertex reachable in that time-local graph, then discard it and advance to the next time.
Reachability exactly captures all simultaneous chains, while separating timestamps prevents information from traveling backward in time.
editorial: Reachability exactly captures all simultaneous chains, while separating timestamps prevents information from traveling backward in time.

tests.explanation: The secret reaches two at time five, three at eight, and five at ten.
At time two person one does not yet know; at time three zero and three spread through the simultaneous component.
